system.description:
She comes down from the high passes when the first real cold sets in, and the old villages of the Boldock Wall still leave out food so she passes them by. Some winters she doesn't take the offering. Those are the bad years.

  • Recipe (1st): Hearthfire Broth.
  • Patron Curse (3rd): Once per day, force a creature within 30ft to make a Fortitude save or its speed is halved by bone-deep cold for the encounter, and it takes 1d6 cold damage (2d6 from 13th) at the start of each of its turns; it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the curse on a success.
  • Physical Change (7th): Frost rimes your hair permanently white regardless of true age, and your breath mists even in warm air.
  • Resistance 5 to cold damage.
  • Once per round, when a creature takes damage from your Hex, a spell you cast or your claw, you may add 1d6 cold damage.
